operations.verify: export PATH="$PWD/.rer-tools/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run source:check && pnpm run verify:base-source && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Retain exact source and applied migration history; capture D1 and every R2 byte consistently before changes. The local product archive excludes Base oa_* authority and is not a full installation backup. Restore to separate resources, reissue credentials after 0009, reconcile uncertain notification attempts, then verify identity, public privacy and provider delivery before switching traffic. See docs/data-ownership.md and docs/disposable-install.md. Installation API keys, provider credentials and signing keys are excluded from portable archives; reconfigure them explicitly. Imported or restored integration events and tracker commands stay held; reconcile uncertain effects before enabling enforcing egress. General tracker sync and automatic publication remain disabled.
